title: The Invasion
source_novel: The War of the Worlds (H. G. Wells, 1898)
audience: Player experienced with Act 1's confirmed controls and baseline combat

campaign_constraints.voluntary_movement: directional swipes cause ground-plane X/Z dashes only
campaign_constraints.attack: tap slash; second quick tap chains one blast; current confirmed screen-relative aim rule unchanged
campaign_constraints.damage: fixed baseline damage; no persistent damage growth

checkpoints.retry: restore a coherent section start; no active hazard at load; ordinary supplies restored
checkpoints.backgrounding: freeze all simulation including cooldowns, warnings and temporary effects
checkpoints.resume: consume overlay tap; continue the frozen state

boss_bait_coordinate_rule.player_aim_anchor: screen-space final finger-release endpoint of the latest swipe
boss_bait_coordinate_rule.boss_bait: actual world X/Z landing after most recent completed dash; use collision-shortened result
boss_bait_coordinate_rule.checkpoint_initialisation: player's actual starting world floor position
boss_bait_coordinate_rule.sampling: sample once at ray-windup start; show world marker and complete short ray lane; never retarget that attack
boss_bait_coordinate_rule.reaction_budget: warning must allow recognition plus remaining dash cooldown plus one normal escape dash

regular_enemies.name: Ray Scout
regular_enemies.role: committed short ray lane; exposed folded mirror housing in recovery

regular_enemies.name: Canister Tender
regular_enemies.role: bounded previewed smoke patch; vulnerable low tube mount while reloading

regular_enemies.name: Salvage Handler
regular_enemies.role: five-legged tool-arm grab/shove; exposed tool mount after commitment

required_design_tests: experienced player scout commitment after one exchange
tender plus handler without all escape pockets blocked
boss world landing vs screen anchor; camera movement, collision-shortened landing, buffered dash and checkpoint initialisation
slash-only boss completion with normal dash and no pickups
local attack source, warning, safe landing and weak point within existing portrait camera
background and resume during warning, active smoke and phase transition
measure complete-level time with transitions; revise estimates from play
